title: Binance Will List WAX (WAXP)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list WAX (WAXP) and will open trading for WAXP/BTC, WAXP/BNB, WAXP/BUSD, WAXP/USDT trading pairs at 2021-08-23 06:30 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  WAXP  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for WAXP will open at 2021-08-24 06:30 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. What is WAX (WAXP)? WAX is a layer-1 network that is built for virtual collectibles and gaming. Users are required to stake WAXP tokens to access network resources (CPU, NET, RAM), which will enable them to access dApps on the network. WAXP tokens can be used to earn staking rewards, governance, and payment for network transactions. WAXP Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
